d:
Shiv panchakshar stotr ko sabse shaktishali shiv mantr kaha gaya hai | iske jap se jatak ke oopar shiv ki kripa barasti hai. shiv ji ki puja karte vakt sadhak ko shiv panchakshar stotr ka jap avashy karna chahie. bhagvan shiv ke is panchakshar stotr ke jap se jivan ke sabhi pap nasht ho jate hain, isse manushy ki sabhi manokamna puri hoti hai evan sabhi prakar ki siddhiyon ko prapt kiya ja sakta hai|
Shiv Panchaksharam By PT. JASRAJ
Singer: PT. JASRAJ
Music Director: Shailendra Bhartti
Lyrics: Traditional
Album: SAMPOORNA SHIV MAHIMNAH STOTRAM
Music Label: T-Series
